Welcome! I am a Max Weber Fellow at the EUI, using computational social science to study democratic backsliding in Europe.
My current research applies machine learning to classify illiberalism in political texts. Previously, I used experiments and quasi-experiments to evaluate the impact of policies across Europe.
I’m always open to explore possible collaborations — let’s connect! You can reach me at: elena.cossu@live.it.

title: Privacy Notice
section: Purpose and Legal Basis of Processing
text:
Purpose and Legal Basis of Processing
This research project analyses publicly available social media communications (Twitter/X posts) of political parties and political figures across seven European countries (Austria, Czechia, France, Hungary, Italy, Poland, United Kingdom), covering the period 2006–2023. The purpose is to study patterns of illiberal and far-right political communication using computational methods.
The legal basis for processing is Article 6(1)(e) GDPR — processing in the public interest and for scientific research purposes — in accordance with EUI Data Protection Policy (President’s Decision No. 10/2019) and Recital 157 GDPR on scientific research.

title: Privacy Notice
text:
Categories of Data Processed
Publicly available posts from official accounts of political parties and their leaders and representatives while in official capacity. No private communications, direct messages, or data from non-public accounts have been collected.

title: Privacy Notice
text:
Data Subjects

Political parties as organizations
Elected officials and party leaders acting in their official public capacity
Any other individuals identifiable through the content of analysed posts

title: Privacy Notice
text:
Notification and Exemption
Given the large number of data subjects across seven countries, individual notification is not feasible without compromising the scientific integrity of the research. This notice therefore fulfils the transparency obligation under EUI President Decision by means of public disclosure, invoking the exemption provided by Article 15(3) of EUI President Decision No. 10/2019 (disproportionate effort), consistent with Recital 157 GDPR on scientific research.

title: Privacy Notice
text:
Data Storage and Security
Data is stored on EUI secure server infrastructure and Sciences Po Paris institutional platforms with EU data residency. Access is restricted to project team members. All files containing identifiable information are encrypted and password-protected. No data is shared via unsecured channels.

title: Privacy Notice
text:
Retention Period
Raw data will be retained for the duration of the project and for a maximum of five years following its conclusion, in line with standard academic data retention practices.

title: Privacy Notice
text:
Your Rights
As a data subject you have the right to:

(a) verify what data is processed about you;
(b) request rectification of factually incorrect data;
(c) request removal of your data if your account has subsequently been made private.

Requests can be submitted to elena.cossu@eui.eu. You will receive a response within 30 working days.
You may also address remarks to the EUI Data Protection Officer at: Data_Protection_Officer@EUI.eu
